title: HTML Styles
text:
HTML
Styles



The HTML
style
attribute is used to add styles to an element, such as color, font, size, and more.

The HTML Style Attribute

Setting the style of an HTML element, can be done with the
style
attribute.

The HTML
style
attribute has the following syntax:

<
tagname

style="
property
:
value;
">

The
property
is a CSS property. The
value
is a CSS value.

You will learn more about CSS later in this tutorial.

Background Color

The CSS
background-color
property defines the background color
for an HTML element.

Text Color

The CSS
color
property defines the text color for
an HTML element:

Fonts

The CSS
font-family
property defines the font to be used
for an HTML element:

Text Size

The CSS
font-size
property defines the text size for
an HTML element:

Text Alignment

The CSS
text-align
property defines the horizontal text alignment for an HTML element:

Chapter Summary

Use the
style
attribute for styling HTML elements

Use
background-color
for background color

Use
color
for text colors

Use
font-family
for text fonts

Use
font-size
for text sizes

Use
text-align
for text alignment
